status: prospectively frozen after observed pilot development and before new calibration or confirmation ranking generation
study_question: Can a fixed learned first-stage utility router reduce required cross-encoder calls while limiting macro-average binary nDCG@10 loss to less than 0.01 versus always-on reranking on untouched positive-tool-component-disjoint queries?
contribution_scope: Empirical transfer and reproducible evaluation of known learned reranker gating to tool retrieval, with component-disjoint supervised-router holdout, measured runtime, and failure analysis; no new gating algorithm or first-of-kind claim.

development.allowed_use: Previously observed pilot; sole supervised router training cohort and sole cohort for fitting feature means and standard deviations. Never counted as confirmation evidence.

calibration.allowed_use: First-stage features and frozen-model predictions only to set routing-score quantiles. No calibration qrels, cross-encoder scores, reranking outcomes, or quality metrics enter model fitting, threshold choice, feature selection, or policy choice.

confirmation.allowed_use: Apply frozen policies once; compute all prespecified results and diagnostic analyses without modifying model, features, thresholds, primary comparison, or tolerance.

partition.component_definition: Transitive connected components through any shared positive gold tool ID over the entire normalized-text-deduplicated eligible universe; component_id is its lexicographically minimum query ID.
partition.assignment_algorithm: Anchor every component containing an observed pilot query; order remaining whole components by ascending SHA256(selection_seed + NUL + component_id), ID tie-break; greedily admit whole components to calibration then confirmation if all remaining source quotas fit; reserve unused components.
required_invariants: No query ID, normalized query text, or positive gold tool ID overlaps among supervised development, calibration, and confirmation.
All pilot-connected component members outside the original 300 pilot are quarantined rather than trained on or evaluated as fresh evidence.
Components are source-exclusive; fail validation if any component spans source domains.
Every positive gold tool ID exists in the fixed retrieval corpus.

retrieval_input: Query field only; instructions, source IDs, split IDs, qrels, and cross-encoder outcomes are not retrieval inputs.
dense_search: Exact normalized float32 dense search over all 37,292 documents; score-descending, ID-ascending ties.
reranking: Score exactly the first 20 RRF candidates; score-descending, ID-ascending ties; preserve the remaining RRF tail unchanged.

utility_router.training_target: Per-development-query binary nDCG@10(always) minus binary nDCG@10(hybrid).
utility_router.standardization: Fit population mean/std (ddof=0) only on the 300 development feature rows; std <= 1e-12 becomes 1. Apply unchanged to calibration and confirmation.
utility_router.regression: Unpenalized intercept equals development target mean; coefficients solve (Z^T Z + 10 I)^-1 Z^T (y - mean(y)). No hyperparameter search.
utility_router.quantile: For budget b use numpy.quantile(calibration_predictions, 1-b, method='linear'). Route iff predicted delta > threshold; all ties skip. Target call rates need not equal realized confirmation rates.

feature_definitions.top1_disagreement: Indicator that BM25 and dense top-1 tool IDs differ.
feature_definitions.top10_jaccard: Intersection size / union size of the first 10 BM25 and dense tool IDs.
feature_definitions.top20_jaccard: Intersection size / union size of the first 20 BM25 and dense tool IDs.
feature_definitions.top20_reciprocal_weighted_jaccard: Over the top20 union, sum min(1/rank_B,1/rank_D) / sum max(1/rank_B,1/rank_D); missing-list weight is zero.
feature_definitions.top20_rank_coherence: 1 minus mean absolute BM25/dense rank difference over the top20 union divided by 20; missing position is 21.
feature_definitions.rrf_top2_normalized_margin: (largest RRF score - second-largest RRF score)/largest score, using both full top100 lists, equal weights and k60; singleton margin is 1.

utility_router.deployment_artifact: Serialize weights, development standardization, calibration thresholds, input/source hashes, and frozen protocol commit before opening confirmation quality results.

primary_analysis.population_estimator: Equal-weight macro-average of the three source-domain query means.
primary_analysis.success_rule: Both source-stratified paired query-bootstrap and source-stratified paired gold-component-bootstrap two-sided 95% interval lower bounds must be strictly greater than -0.01, and utility_75 must require fewer CE calls than always on the full confirmation cohort.
primary_analysis.tolerance_interpretation: 0.01 is a predeclared absolute nDCG engineering loss tolerance, not an externally established practical-equivalence threshold. No a priori power guarantee is claimed.
primary_analysis.failure_rule: If either lower bound is <= -0.01, call the quality criterion inconclusive or failed as appropriate; do not infer no difference from a confidence interval crossing zero. Report the fixed result without retuning.
primary_analysis.compute_interpretation: Full-cohort tables count deterministic policy-required CE calls/pairs. Execute the primary gate on all 1,500 cached first-stage query rankings to verify actual conditional CE calls and exact output equality. True end-to-end timing is measured separately on the 90-query subset. Other policies' full-cohort compute is offline accounting.

compute_metrics: Actual conditional CE invocations in full-cohort primary runtime verification
Measured warm CPU query-to-ranking latency on the predefined subset
fixed_disagreement_gate: Rerank iff BM25 top-1 differs from dense top-1.
cheap_jaccard_gate: Rerank iff top10 BM25/dense Jaccard overlap is strictly less than 0.5; no calibration or tuning.

random_controls.global: For each utility budget and fixed_disagreement, select exactly its realized confirmation call count uniformly without replacement for each of the 20 seeds.
random_controls.source_matched: For utility_75 and fixed_disagreement additionally select exactly each policy's realized call count within every source for the same 20 seeds.
random_controls.summary: Report mean and full seed range, plus exploratory paired comparison to the per-query mean of random-policy outcomes; seed range is not a confidence interval for new-query performance.

oracle_diagnostic: For each realized budget, use true confirmation nDCG(always)-nDCG(hybrid) to choose the highest-gain queries; oracle outcomes are an unattainable label-aware upper-bound diagnostic, never a deployable policy or primary finding.

bootstrap.query: Within each source, resample its 500 confirmation queries with replacement, retaining paired policy outcomes; average source query means with weights 1/3.
bootstrap.component: Within each source, sample its gold-tool connected components with replacement, retaining all component members and paired policy outcomes. For each source compute the ratio of summed query scores to resampled query count, then macro-average the three source ratios with weights 1/3. Resampled query counts may vary.
bootstrap.pairing: Use identical resample draws for all policy comparisons of a given bootstrap type.
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: Only utility_75 vs always is the primary quality/compute hypothesis. All other budgets, baselines, random comparisons, source results, feature associations, and failure cases are exploratory and do not replace the primary policy.

latency_benchmark.selection: Within each source select ascending SHA256(selection_seed + NUL + query_id), ID tie-break, with no quality/timing inspection.
latency_benchmark.schedule: Shuffle query order and a base policy permutation for each repetition; cyclically rotate policy order by query position modulo four to balance ordinal positions.
latency_benchmark.warmup: One full request per policy on non-benchmark query 'weather forecast'; all warmup excluded.
latency_benchmark.measurement_boundary: perf_counter_ns sequential query text to final ranking: BM25, dense query encoding, exact full-corpus dense search/sort, RRF, actual routing features/prediction, and conditional CE/prefix sort.
latency_benchmark.primary_distributions: Mean, p50 and p95 of per-query latency means over three repetitions; repetitions are not independent query observations.
latency_benchmark.uncertainty: Paired source-stratified query bootstrap over each query's repetition mean, 10,000 draws and seed20261003; report differences and reductions vs always.
latency_benchmark.secondary_distribution: P50/p95 across all timing events explicitly labeled as event-level distributions.
latency_benchmark.runtime_validation: After timing, validate every actual first-stage and final ranking against frozen cache expectations, and log actual CE calls and pairs.
latency_benchmark.execution_condition: Run without concurrent corpus/ranking generation or other heavy model workloads on the same machine; report machine/library versions and thread configuration.

failure_diagnostics.scope: Exploratory benchmark-qrel failure analysis; no model/policy repair using confirmation labels.
failure_diagnostics.skip_outcomes: Harmful skip means true per-query nDCG(always)-nDCG(hybrid)>0 and the policy skips; beneficial skip means delta<0 and skips; unchanged means delta=0. Report counts and summed quality losses/gains, not proven tool-execution failures.
failure_diagnostics.candidate_scope: Report fixed-prefix gold coverage and reranking promotion/demotion to distinguish candidate-generation limitations from within-prefix ranking changes.
failure_diagnostics.case_selection: Any qualitative examples must disclose deterministic selection rules and query IDs; do not present selected examples as representative prevalence estimates.

completion_criteria: Freeze this protocol and hash-linked split manifests in Git before new ranking generation.
Fit and serialize the router using old development labels only and calibration features only, before confirmation quality inspection.
Evaluate all 1,500 confirmation queries and publish every prespecified policy, source result, and uncertainty interval whether positive or negative.
Verify primary real conditional CE execution and rank equality on all 1,500 queries; publish required and actual call counts with clear scope.
Finish the repeated 90-query actual CPU end-to-end benchmark with raw timing events and runtime invariants.
Publish provenance, raw per-query results, model artifact, tests, independent audit, reproduction commands, and a technical report with limitations.
Update the resume to reflect only verified findings; a negative or inconclusive primary result does not make the scoped empirical study unfinished.

prior_work.role: Direct prior work on learned pre-reranker feature gating, held-out selection, matched random controls, and harmful-skip reporting; learned gating is not claimed as new here.

prior_work.role: Existing budget-aware tool retrieval with execution-aware planning; not a same-configuration numerical baseline.

limitations: Positive tool-ID connected components are not verified API families; no API-family generalization claim.
The retrieval corpus contains held-out relevant tools; the holdout concerns supervised router query/tool-label exposure, not absent corpus tools.
Frozen public model checkpoints may have prior exposure to public benchmark content; project-level holdout does not establish pretraining independence.
Benchmark binary qrels may be incomplete. All-positive-label coverage is not a verified mandatory-tool set or task execution success.
Single-machine warm sequential CPU measurements do not establish GPU, remote serving, queueing, or concurrency performance.
No external faculty supervision, peer review, publication acceptance, new algorithm, or state-of-the-art claim is implied.
The declared 0.01 quality tolerance is an engineering choice; uncertainty and component dependence remain visible in all conclusions.
